headlines.title: Schwab Declares Quarterly Common Stock Dividend and Declares Preferred Stock Dividends
headlines.summary: WESTLAKE, Texas, October 22, 2026--The Board of Directors of The Charles Schwab Corporation at its meeting today declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.32 per common share.

headlines.title: Zoe Financial CEO Andres Garcia-Amaya to Speak on Growth at Charles Schwab IMPACT(R) 2026
headlines.summary: Next week, Zoe's founder will join a panel of RIA leaders to talk about how firms can grow and still give great service to clientsNEW YORK CITY, NY / ACCESS Newswire / October 22, 2026 / , a wealth management platform helping registered investment advisers (RIAs) grow more efficiently and deliver personalized investment solutions to their clients, today shared that its CEO and Founder, Andres Garcia-Amaya, CFA, will speak at IMPACT® 2026, hosted by Charles Schwab.

headlines.title: ETF Central: An Introduction to the Schwab International Bond ETF
headlines.summary: Riz Hussain, investment strategist and portfolio consultant, and John Greves, managing director and head of multi-asset strategy at Schwab Asset Management, join Bilal Little on ETF Central to discuss Schwab’s new international bond index, built in partnership with ICE. They walk through how the index is constructed, including its focus on investment-grade bonds from developed markets and its approach to currency exposure. The conversation covers the current interest rate environment, differences in central bank policy around the world, and how the index fits into the broader portfolio construction process at Schwab. They also address common questions about international bonds, including how to source the allocation, the role of duration, and how the index compares with domestic fixed income.

headlines.title: Schwab Withholds 10% From an IRA Withdrawal Unless You Change One Line on the Form. For a Retiree in the 24% Bracket That’s a $7,000 Surprise in April on a $50,000 Distribution
headlines.summary: Most retirees assume their IRA custodian withholds enough to cover their tax bill, and that assumption costs them thousands every April. The reason traces back to a single line on a form that almost nobody changes.

headlines.title: The Banks Locked Agents Out. This Week an Agent Paid an Invoice Through the Front Door.
headlines.summary: Between October 13 and October 16, JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America, Citi, Schwab, and Wells Fargo locked AI agents out of consumer accounts. The response included four hard blocks and one contract rewrite.

description: The Charles Schwab Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a savings and loan holding company that provides wealth management, securities brokerage, banking, asset management, custody, and financial advisory services in the United States and internationally. The company operates in two segments, Investor Services and Advisor Services. It offers brokerage accounts with equity and fixed income trading, margin lending, options trading, futures and forex trading, and cash management capabilities, including money market funds, and certificates of deposit; third-party mutual funds through the Mutual Fund Marketplace and Mutual Fund OneSource service, as well as mutual fund trading and clearing services to broker-dealers; exchange-traded funds; advisory solutions for managed portfolios, separately managed accounts, customized personal advice for tailored portfolios, specialized planning, and full-time portfolio management; banking products comprising checking and savings accounts, first lien residential real estate mortgage loans, home equity lines of credit, and pledged asset lines; and trust custody services, personal trust reporting services, and administrative trustee services. It provides digital and software based trading platforms; research tools, and multichannel support, real-time market data, options trading; equity compensation plan sponsors full-service recordkeeping for stock plans, stock options, restricted stock, performance shares, and stock appreciation rights; retirement plan services; mutual fund clearing services; and advisor services, including interactive tools and educational content. The Company operates through branch offices. The Charles Schwab Corporation was founded in 1971 and is headquartered in Westlake, Texas.
